notes.title: Play the Big Fall Update Now!
notes.notes:
Hi y'all! I am very excited to say that Fossil Corner's Fall Update is now available for everyone! It's a huge update, and I hope you all enjoy!

Game is 20% off this weekend to celebrate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222622/47f18c3823acd161cf92a09405f0a9c87314dbea.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Collect a new type of fossil, the strange & beautiful [b]Crinoids[/b]!
[*] Pull open the barn doors and let the sun shine in in your [b]New Workspace![/b]
[*] Use the [b]Scrapbook App[/b] to create scrapbooks of your collection!
[*] Unlock new items, like the [b]Record Player[/b], [b]Printer[/b], & [b]Eurypterid Pillow[/b]!
[*] And a lot more!
[/list]
Now that this update is done, I'm planning on moving on to working on new projects. This game has been a real treat to make.

Thanks again to everyone who's played. You have all been so supportive and kind! I feel very lucky.

<3 Brady

notes.title: Big Fall Update coming in October!
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

Ok! Hype news! The [b]BIG FALL UPDATE[/b] is now done with feature development, and is entering beta testing this week! That means the update will be coming in October!

Here's a lil' preview of what the update contains:

- A new fossil type, Crinoids!
- A new workspace!
- A new app for your computer, the Scrapbook!
- Many more items and features, including a record player, a printer, a new level for Fossil Finders, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222622/da89b083f8df95420155d0d0006589c431cce7ce.png[/img]

<3 y'all!

Brady

notes.title: Big Free Update in the Works!
notes.notes:
Hi! Hope you all have been good. I've been kind of taking a break for the past few weeks, finishing a game is nuts. But now I'm back! And good news:  [b]Fossil Corner is getting a big free update![/b]

Adding:
[list]
[*] A new type of fossil! 🐚❓
[*] More story emails / a new mechanic that lets you know when you've reached the end of the story✍
[*]  New unlockables and items (including some new music from Dylan & Bobby!) 🎶🎵 
[*] And more!
[/list]
The update will take a while, because it's pretty big! I'd expect it to be ready in early Fall. I'll post about it [url=https://twitter.com/bradysoglin]on my Twitter[/url] if you want to see it while it's WIP.

Anyways, thanks to everyone who's played the game / left nice reviews :) the response to this game has been truly wonderful

<3 Brady
